en.html:
From morning itself, something about the air had felt wrong. By noon there was no mistaking it.
Yesterday and today, clearly not the same.

The dangerous battle-feeling that had pricked the skin was thinning out. On the soldiers' faces in town, excitement and tension were giving way to bewilderment and relief.
en.text:
From morning itself, something about the air had felt wrong. By noon there was no mistaking it.
Yesterday and today, clearly not the same.

The dangerous battle-feeling that had pricked the skin was thinning out. On the soldiers' faces in town, excitement and tension were giving way to bewilderment and relief.

ja.html:
朝からどこかおかしかった空気は、昼に差し掛かる
と決定的だった。
　昨日までとは明らかに異なる。

　肌を刺す剣呑な戦気が、薄い。
　街で見かける兵士達の表情は興奮と緊張から、困惑
と安堵のそれに移り変わりつつある。

en.html:
And at the front?
Compared with before, the attacks were smaller, coming only now and then.

Enough to keep the castle's defenders in check, probably.
But beyond that, nothing.
en.text:

ja.html:
そして前線。
　攻勢がこれまでと比較して小規模かつ散発的だった。

　城側への牽制としては充分だろう。
　しかし、それ以上のものではない。
ja.text:

en.html:
What else could they be preparing for?

Something must have happened. What, though?
The fighting had become almost even, but the attackers should still have held the advantage.

Had their supplies been cut off in the rear?
...For that, they were showing very little anxiety.

This was not adding up.
en.text:
What else could they be preparing for?

Something must have happened. What, though?
The fighting had become almost even, but the attackers should still have held the advantage.

Had their supplies been cut off in the rear?
...For that, they were showing very little anxiety.

This was not adding up.

ja.html:
そのための用意をしているとしか思えなかった。

　何があったのだろう。
　情況が互角に近くなっていたとはいえ、まだ攻城側
の優勢だったはずなのだが。

　後方で補給を断たれでもしたのだろうか。
　……それにしては焦っている様子があまりない。

　どうも不可解だった。

en.html:
A chance.

Now—now that the fighting was dying down.

I could get inside that castle.

I could go to Kageaki!

ja.html:
好機だ。

　今なら――戦闘が沈静化しつつある今なら。

　あの城の中に入れる。

　景明のもとへ行ける！
